parse.title: Guide:Ironman Multiquest
parse.wikitext:
== Getting Started ==
{{Checklist|title=Lumbridge|
* Complete Tutorial Island
* Start [[Rune Mysteries]]
* Pick up jug and knife in kitchen
* Start [[X Marks the Spot]]
* Dig once for X Marks the Spot
* Start [[Restless Ghost]]
* Start and Complete [[Misthalin Mystery]]
* Speak to Father Urhney
* Pick up the leather gloves
* Start [[Lost City]]
* Run to Wizard's Tower and continue Rune Mysteries
}}
{{Checklist|title=Very early GP|
* Minigame teleport to Bounty Hunter
* Regen energy with pool (do this every time you teleport here)
* Bank deposit all, withdraw 10gp, ghostspeak (equip) and all food
* Pick up 2x iron bar, 25x steel platelegs
* Die, reclaim through death in Lumbridge (confirm in dialogue)
* Speak to ghost for Restless Ghost
* Walk Al Kharid
* Start [[Prince Ali Rescue]]
* Sell 12x platelegs to [[Louie Legs]], hop once, sell 13x more '''(14.7k GP)'''
* Buy 2 silk from silk trader
}}
{{Checklist|title=Early quest walking|
* '''Buy Shantay (edit): 5 ropes, 10 bronze bars, 3 bowls of water, 1 jug of water, 1 hammer, 1 feather, 4 buckets of water'''
* Bank deposit all, withdraw coins
* Shantay teleport to Port Sarim
* Start and Complete [[Pandemonium]]
* '''Buy and deposit box Pandemonium bar (edit): 5 beers, 26 wine, 3 vodka, 20 stew''' (14.3k GP)
* '''Buy Port Sarim (edit): 3 redberries, 2 pots of flour, raw beef, raw chicken, cabbage, chocolate bar, cheese, raw sardine, lobster pot'''
* '''Buy Betty (edit, no staff!): black wizard hat, eye of newt, 206 airs, 200 minds, 6 water, 6 earth (12.6k GP)'''
* Kill a giant rat, pick up the meat
* Take a spade (scenery object in mine)
* Pick 1 onion, pick up 1 snape grass
* Burn log near Betty
* Start and Complete [[Witch's Potion]]
* Pick up ashes
* Take ship to Ardougne
* Bank all, withdraw gp
* Start [[Sheep Herder]] (equip items for space)
* Buy 25 balls of wool and 2 papyrus
* Bank withdraw axe, jug of water, GP, 5 wines, airs and minds
* Start and Complete [[Monk's Friend]], [[Clock Tower]], [[Hazeel Cult]], [[Tree Gnome Village]], [[Fight Arena]]
* During Tree Gnome Village kill a grizzly bear just south of fruit tree patch, pick up the meat
* Spirit tree to Gnome Stronghold
* Start [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]]
* '''Buy (edit): dwellberries, 4 onions, pots of flour, milk, steel axe'''
* Minigame Ferox (energy, soul wars portal, edgeville)
* Bank withdraw 4 buckets of water, airs/minds, spade, dwellberries, hangover cure (milk, choc, knife, snape grass)
* Lever to Ardougne
* Start and Complete [[Plague City]]
* Start and continue [[Biohazard]] until you need to go to Rimmington
* Bank, withdraw Biohazard items, axe, tinderbox, pickaxe
* Mine (use logs to speed up) 16 clay, 4 copper, 2 iron
* '''Walk/run Falador?''' Bank, buy 2 woad leaves, wiz. mind bomb, start [[The Knight's Sword]], [[Black Knights' Fortress]], die
* Bank (PvP world), buy + deposit 14 steel/iron battleaxes (2k GP), withdraw 20 wool, spade, axe
* Continue [[X Marks the Spot]]
* Start and Complete [[Sheep Shearer]]
* Chop 3 oak logs, shear 1 sheep
* Start [[Ides of milk]]
* Continue Prince Ali until you get the mould
* Start [[Vampyre Slayer]], [[A Porcine of Interest]]
* Continue X marks the spot
* Buy '''Chronicle and 5 cards''' (1k GP)
* Continue Porcine of Interest at farm
* Buy '''Farming Supplies, deposit box'''
* Pick up 2 eggs
* Start [[Corsairs Curse]]
* Start and continue [[Pirate's Treasure]] until you need to go to Varrock
* Complete X marks the spot
* Start and Complete [[Client of Kourend]], use the minecarts, read 2 below (11.4k GP)
* During Client Buy '''staff of air, 200 more minds, 100 waters, (edit) tele runes''' (8.7k GP)
* During Client make key for Prince Ali
* Chronicle to Varrock '''4'''
* Bank '''edit see below'''
* Buy '''Pink skirt, priest robes, chisel, iron chainbody, adamant sword, 90 steel nails'''
* Make 2 redberry pies during the trips, pick up 4 more redberries
* Start and Complete [[Romeo & Juliet]], [[Daddy's Home]], [[Gertrude's Cat]], [[Shield of Arrav]], [[Children of the Sun]]
* Start and Continue [[Demon Slayer]] until you have 2 keys
* Start [[Priest in Peril]], [[Family Crest]]
* Continue [[The Knight's Sword]], [[Biohazard]], [[Rune Mysteries]], [[Pirate's Treasure]], [[Vampyre Slayer]]
* Bank knife, rope, spade, air strikes, wines
* '''Mage XP?'''
* Home Teleport/Die
* Continue Ides of Milk until speak Cassius
* Walk Draynor Manor
* Start and Complete [[Ernest the Chicken]]
* Complete [[Vampyre Slayer]]
* Pick up Bronze Med
* Dig behind manor for FTP1 skull
* Continue Porcine until cutscene to draynor
* Make blue/red/yellow dye for Goblin Diplomacy
* Continue Prince Ali until you need to go to Al Kharid
* Bank '''25 bones! Edit above!''', box for Rune Mysteries
* Continue Demon Slayer, Restless Ghost
* Complete Rune Mysteries
* Die, Bank (PvP world) coins, ghostspeak amulet, redberry pie, 2 house teleports, falador teleport, pickaxe, wine, 2 iron bars
* Complete Restless Ghost
* Complete Prince Ali
* Unlock Sorceress's Garden (speak to Osman)
* House teleport, Continue Knight's Sword until you have the sword
* Minigame teleport Bounty Hunter
* Bank iron chain, cabbage, bronze med, cheese, leather gloves, ritual meats, goblin dyes, wines, runes, Knights' Sword, GP
* Run/walk south, start [[Into the Abyss]]
* Continue Black Knights' Fortress
* Start and Complete [[Goblin Diplomacy]], [[Doric's Quest]]
* Start and Continue [[Witch's House]] until have ball
* Start [[Fishing Contest]]
* Start and Complete [[Druidic Ritual]], Buy Pestle and Mortar and Vials
* Complete Witch's House
* Walk Falador, Complete Knight's Sword, Black Knight's Fortress
* Start and Complete [[Recruitment Drive]] '''Might need more melee lvls'''
* Minigame teleport Sorceress's Garden
* Start and Complete [[The Tourist Trap]], XP on Agility '''EDIT 10 fletching'''
* Minigame teleport Giant's Foundary
* Start and Complete [[Sleeping Giants]]
* Make 2 swords (24k GP?)
* Minigame teleport Soul Wars
* Bank hammer, wines, sheep herder outfit, rope, air/water/earth runes, axe, house teleport, adamant sword
* Lever to Ardougne
* Continue Sheep Herder, kill all sheep
* Start [[Dwarf Cannon]], Continue until you need to go to goblin cave
* Start [[Waterfall Quest]], Continue until pebble
* Canoe to battlefield take spirit tree to village, get pebble
* Spirit tree to battlefield canoe north, continue Dwarf Cannon until you need to go to Falador
* Complete Waterfall Quest
* House teleport ('''3 used'''), complete Corsairs Curse
* Bank Chronicle, bark sample and translation, pickaxe
* Minigame teleport NMZ
* Continue Grand Tree
* Chronicle Varrock '''again Varrock?''' start [[Dragon Slayer I]]
* Continue Into the Abyss, mine 24 essence, bank silverlight keys
* Continue Demon Slayer get Silverlight
* Spirit tree Gnome Stronghold, continue Grand Tree
* From shipyard, minigame Soul Wars, continue Dragon Slayer, spirit tree Stronghold from GE
* Finish The Grand Tree (water strike)
* Chronicle (bank all, silverlight few wines), continue Dragon Slayer, finish Demon Slayer
* Die, claim Anti-Dragon Shield, bank 2 soft clay '''lobster pot, silk, wiz. mind bomb''', wines, teleport Barb. Village from Count Check
* Finish Stronghold of Security, make unfired bowl + varrock easy
* Continue DS1 (oracle, mine), Continue Dwarf Cannon
* Minigame Ferox, bank runes, sword, wines, law rune, 2k coins, maze key, house tab, 3 planks, 90 nails
* House teleport, continue DS1 until you fix boat '''33 magic?'''
* Home teleport, bank (PvP) milk, sword, map, casts, food
* Complete Ides of Milk ('''1k prayer?''')
* Kill Sourhog Porcine, Continue at Sarah
* Speak Ned DS1
* Complete Porcine of Interest
* Minigame Sorceress's Garden
* Bank Elvarg, Shantay teleport, Kill Elvarg, unlock shortcut
* Minigame Soul Wars, Complete Dragon Slayer 1

* '''Next: grand tree, sots, feud, rfd miniquests, morytania etc.'''
}}
